footer.tagline: Made in Chile for pesos, dollars and UF.

home.lead: A shared credit pool, business-day closings and instalments, the way your bank charges them. No invented figures.

1.title: No invented figures
1.body: We don't calculate your bank's interest or convert currencies for you. When a figure is missing, we say so instead of guessing.

2.title: Everything reversible
2.body: Undoing a debt payment gives the balance back. Deleting an instalment plan reverses its whole history, and tells you what it will move before it does.

3.title: Chile first, done properly
3.body: Legal holidays, RUT check digit, the UF, the local bank and cooperative catalogue. Better one country done right than many done halfway.

why.title: Built so your numbers match your bank's

cards.title: One shared pool, like your bank's
cards.body: The primary card and its add-ons draw from the same pool, unless you give one its own sub-limit per currency. Never an available amount your bank wouldn't recognize.

calendar.title: Closes in business days, with Chilean holidays
calendar.body: You choose how many business days pass until closing, and how many until payment is due. Chile's legal holidays are already counted, so the date matches your real statement.

currencies.title: Pesos, dollars and UF, each on their own
currencies.body: Every account lives in its own currency with its own total. No automatic conversion mixing figures that were never meant to add up.

closing.title: Your cash account comes ready
closing.body: Log your first expense today and add your banks and cards whenever you like.

about.lead: Almost every app treats a credit card as just another account. A purchase lowers your balance and instalments show up in full. Your bank doesn't work that way.

how.body: Every feature starts from a real rule of a Chilean bank or issuer, never from whatever looks simplest in a mockup. When the model has no way to support a figure honestly, the app says so instead of inventing it.

noInvented.title: No invented figures
noInvented.body: We don't calculate your bank's interest or convert currencies. When a figure is missing, we say so instead of guessing.
noInvented.example: Revolving interest is copied from your statement as a finance charge. The app never calculates a rate.

reversible.title: Everything reversible
reversible.body: Undoing a debt payment gives the balance back. Deleting an instalment plan reverses its whole history, and tells you what it will move before it does.
reversible.example: Before deleting an instalment plan you see how much goes back to each account, and only then confirm.

chileFirst.title: Chile first, done properly
chileFirst.body: Legal holidays, RUT check digit, the UF, the local bank and cooperative catalogue. One country done right, before many done halfway.
chileFirst.example: A card that closes every 20 business days skips September 18 and 19 without you fixing the date.

available.title: Available
available.body: Accounts, cards, movements, billing, instalments, goals, debts and recurring expenses, in pesos, dollars and UF.

paused.title: Paused
paused.body: Investment tracking (returns, prices) is paused: the investment account type still exists, tracking doesn't yet.

pending.title: Pending
pending.body: Exporting your data and automatic bank sync don't exist yet. The second one may come later.

privacy.titleLead: Your data, in layers you can
privacy.lead: Your balances, movements and debts describe your financial situation. That's why they're treated as sensitive data, protected in five layers.

consent.title: Consent
consent.lead: Consent to process your financial information is asked for separately, never dissolved into an “I accept the terms”.

a.title: Explicit and versioned
a.body: Every consent is dated and tagged with the policy version you accepted, viewable from your profile.

b.title: Minors
b.body: Registration with a parent or guardian's authorization, stored as a consent of its own.

access.title: How you sign in
access.lead: You sign in with your RUT, like at your bank. Email is only for notices.

a.title: Passkey
a.body: If your device supports it, a passkey skips both password and second factor: it's already strong authentication on its own.

b.title: Second factor
b.body: TOTP with recovery codes. Changing it closes every other session, in the same transaction.

sessions.title: Sessions you close instantly
sessions.lead: Closing a session kills its access on the very next request, not on its next refresh.

a.title: One device per row
a.body: See where you signed in from and how long ago, and close any of them except the one you're using.

b.title: Kept, not erased
b.body: A closed session stays visible for 3 days before it's deleted, so you can confirm it was you.

visible.title: What only you see
visible.lead: A switch in your profile masks the app's amounts, with a one-off reveal whenever you need it.

a.title: Hide balances
a.body: Useful for checking your accounts when there's people around.

b.title: Your receipts
b.body: Validated by their real content, not their file extension, and opened through a signed link that expires in five minutes.

leave.title: How you leave
leave.lead: Deleting your account is a real action, not a checkbox that disables it.

a.title: Full deletion
a.body: Erases your account and everything you recorded, with nothing left behind.

b.title: Or anonymization
b.body: Keeps your financial history with nothing left that identifies you, if you'd rather keep that.

cardNumber.title: We don't store the full number
cardNumber.body: Only the last four digits. The full number never leaves your browser and the CVV is never asked for.

estimates.title: We don't calculate or estimate for you
estimates.body: No interest, no exchange rate, no “projected” expense you never entered.

banks.title: We don't connect to your bank
banks.body: There's no automatic sync and no read permission over your products. Nothing enters that you didn't record yourself.

pricing.lead: Today there's a single option, and it's free.
pricing.freeHint: No tiers, no artificial limits and no locked features.

included.accounts: Every account and card you have
included.movements: Movements, transfers and receipts with no cap
included.billing: Billing, instalments, goals, debts and recurring expenses
included.security: Passkey, second factor and session control

whyFree.title: Why it doesn't cost anything
whyFree.body: The expensive part of a finance app is connecting to banks: an intermediary is paid for every account. Cuadra doesn't connect, so it doesn't carry that cost.

notYourData.title: Your data isn't the price
notYourData.body: No ads, no profiling for third parties and your movements are never sold. Free here means free, not “paid for some other way”.

changes.title: If anything changes, we say so first
changes.body: If some part ever has a real cost (storing a lot of receipts, say), it's announced before it happens, with the option to take your data with you. Nothing turns paid overnight.

faq.subtitle: The doubts that come up in the first month, grouped by topic. If something's missing here, the answer is almost always the same: the app doesn't show a figure it can't back up.

bankSync.q: Does it connect to my bank?
bankSync.a: No. You record your own accounts and movements. It's more work on day one, and in exchange, no app has read access over your products.

setup.q: Do I have to set everything up before using it?
setup.a: No. Your cash account is created with you, at zero, so you can log an expense on day one and add your accounts and cards whenever you have time.

conversion.q: Does it convert between pesos, dollars and UF?
conversion.a: No. Each account lives in its own currency and every total is shown separately, so you never get a sum your bank wouldn't recognize.

investments.q: Does it work for my investments?
investments.a: You can have an investment account and record its movements, but tracking of instruments and returns doesn't exist yet. We'd rather say so than show you an empty screen.

creditBalance.q: Why didn't my credit card purchase lower my balance?
creditBalance.a: Because it shouldn't. A credit purchase raises your used credit, not your balance: the money moves once, later, when you pay the statement.

closing.a: Whenever you say: you set how many business days pass since the previous close, or a fixed day of the month if your issuer works that way. Chile's holidays are already counted, and the due date is configured separately.

partialPayment.q: What happens if I pay less than the total?
partialPayment.a: The period settles and whatever you didn't cover carries to the next one as a prior balance, with a record of where it went. Your credit only frees up by what you actually paid.

additionalCard.q: Does an additional card spend from my same pool?
additionalCard.a: Yes, same as your bank, unless you give it its own sub-limit, which is still capped by the account's own pool. Each card also shows how much it spent on its own.

interest.q: Does it calculate the interest I'm charged?
interest.a: No, on purpose: inventing a rate would make your numbers stop matching your real statement. You log it as a finance charge and it's added in where it belongs.

signIn.a: With your RUT and password, or a passkey if your device supports it. Email is only used for notices.

deleteAccount.q: Can I really delete my account?
deleteAccount.a: Yes. You can erase everything, or keep your history with nothing left that identifies you. Either way your sessions and passkeys are removed.

minors.q: I'm a minor, can I use it?
minors.a: Yes, with authorization from your mother, father or guardian. The sign-up form asks for it on its own. Their RUT isn't stored as is, only a fingerprint that can't be turned back into it, because they're a third party and not a user of the app.

cta.title: Still have a question?
cta.body: Creating an account takes a minute and commits you to nothing: you can log your first expense in cash.
